title: OCC Finalizes Stablecoin Framework as January Compliance Date Approaches
snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) has finalized rules governing stablecoin issuers under its jurisdiction, establishing standards for reserves, redemption, custody and risk management ahead of a January deadline. title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers and custody
snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency’s final rule covers payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January.

title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
snippet: The rule sets reserve, redemption and risk standards for issuers, but the OCC has yet to say when it will begin accepting applications.

snippet: Zcash verifies transactions without revealing the sender, recipient, or amount. In comments to the SEC, @pgpzcash urges regulators to ensure proposed crypto fundraising rules don't require public transaction histories, viewing keys, or disabling shielded transfers.

title: First out the gate: OCC debuts final rule implementing Trump-signed GENIUS Act
snippet: OCC published its final GENIUS Act stablecoin rule, effective Jan. 18, dropping a proposed presumption on third-party rewards arrangements.
